{{Quote|I only know the general location of where it might be found. However, I have heard that many treasures can be found in a pirate hideout.|[[Demitri Firewatcher]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Demitri Firewatcher|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Pirate Bunker''' was a bunker located on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and controlled by a group of [[Naboo pirates|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Please send help. These pirates are holding several members of the royal family and intend to execute them if their ransom is not met. They believe their base is still secret.|A transmission picked up on Naboo emergency frequencies|<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
The Pirate Bunker was located in an isolated area of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:PB" /> The building was deserted until the pirates decided to inhabit it and used it as their headquarters.<ref name="SWG:KY">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ketter Yaaran|Naboo}}</ref>

[[File:PirateBunkerPrisoners.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Prisoners held inside the Pirate Bunker]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the pirates kidnapped several [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] all over the planet and kept them prisoners in the bunker for ransom.<ref name="SWG:KY" /> People captured included [[Demitri Firewatcher]]'s master,<ref name="SWG:DF" /> [[Hanna S'kiyah]]'s sister,<ref name="SWG:HS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Hannah S'kiyah|Naboo}}</ref> and even several members of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal family]].<ref name="10HSTG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Demitri Firewatcher solicited the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] while he was in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. He asked the the spacer rescue his master. Firewatcher used rumors of [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure]] in the bunker to further catch the spacer's interest. The spacer agreed to rescue the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], and Firewatcher recommended that a group be formed to overwhelm the more numerous pirates.<ref name="SWG:DF" /> In the meantime, Hanna S'kiyah also begged a spacer to rescue her sister from the bunker.<ref name="SWG:HS" /> A spacer also met a man known as [[Ketter Yaaran]] in the [[Kaadara]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to get information about the pirates and their bunker.<ref name="SWG:KY" />

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bronell]] dispatched a spacer to the pirate bunker in order to retrieve information about a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who owned money to Jabba, as well as to the pirates.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bronell"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pirate Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:PB" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Pirate Bunker was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
